vendors.name: SumUp Kvik Order
vendors.reason: SumUp Denmark's restaurant online-ordering page ('Onlinebestilling, nu med indbygget SumUp-onlinebetaling', 'Udviklet til travle restauranter'; '1.25%' transaction fee, 'Ingen faste omkostninger. Ingen binding.') - but no pickup, pre-order or chosen-time wording on the page, so the order-ahead rule is not met. A real food tool, unlike SumUp's web shop: worth a second page read if the coordinator wants it.

vendors.name: OrderYOYO
vendors.reason: Danish (OrderYOYO A/S) own-website ordering for takeaways; its online-ordering page has no pickup/pre-order wording and no price ('low commission fees on online orders', 'Request info'). Unpriced.

vendors.name: OnlinePOS
vendors.reason: Danish POS with a takeaway module ('only a fixed and low amount per month') but no kr. amount for it in search; Premium '+300 DKK per month' on top of an unstated base. Not opened.

notes: DK counts Truckly and NemTakeAway. No third found. SumUp's Danish Kvik Order page is a restaurant online-ordering product with a price (1.25 % per transaction, no fixed cost) but shows no pickup / order-ahead wording; OrderYOYO and OnlinePOS show no price.
